card.name: Inside long drug and study names
card.fires_on: Partway through a longer word in oncology label text, such as carb|op|latin, metast|atic, brand names like LORBRENA, or the GALLIUM study name. It fires on the middle piece before the word is complete.

modes.label: Drug names
modes.description: The middle piece of a chemotherapy or brand drug name.
modes.example: in combination with carb<<op>>latin and pemetrexed infusions

modes.label: Metastatic
modes.description: The piece "atic" completing metastatic before a lung cancer term.
modes.example: for the treatment of metast<<atic>> NSCLC are provided in Tables

modes.label: Study names
modes.description: The end piece of a trial name such as GALLIUM.
